versions.changelog:
- Documentation updated: SKILL.md streamlined to clarify trigger word usage and improved instructions.
- Added acceptance criteria and CLI installation guide in the references directory.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.
- Various scripts updated: caller.py, lib.py, pyproject.toml, and smoke_test.py received functional or structural adjustments.
- No breaking changes; primarily documentation improvements and structural enhancements.

- Initial release of the one-click deployment skill for Hermes on Huawei Cloud Flexus L instances.
- Supports automated deployment, ModelArts large model configuration, and robot channel configuration via interactive or scripted commands.
- Provides detailed command-line usage for deployment, model setup, channel setup (Feishu, WeCom, DingTalk, etc.), gateway management, and status querying.
- Includes strict security guidelines for handling and executing scripts using Huawei Cloud credentials.
- Comprehensive documentation on prerequisites, architecture, and supported operations for both long-term and temporary credentials.
